structured.answer: According to the page, the cheapest place is a securities account at Psagot (פסגות ניירות ערך) with the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 fund. I'd put in 135,000 ₪ and have about 179,889 ₪ after 15 years, after fees and tax and "בכסף של היום". It counts prices rising by 2% a year and assumes the fund earns 7% a year.

stuck.why: It opens with English letters (S&P, MSCI) and the word מדד, and the background is dark. If I hadn't been given this task I would have felt it wasn't for me and left.
It says only "בכסף של היום" with no percent. I had to press the "אינפלציה" button to find the 2%.
There are many colours and numbers, with a big red-pink stripe of 15,364. It made me anxious and I didn't understand it.

used: Boxes סכום היום / הפקדה חודשית / שנים
The big number 179,889 ₪ with "נשאר לכם בעוד 15 שנים, אחרי דמי ניהול ומס, בכסף של היום"
The "אינפלציה" button's window: אינפלציה בשנה 2%, "בכמה המחירים עולים בשנה, בממוצע"
Account card פסגות ניירות ערך בע"מ and fund card ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500
skipped: Coloured cost bar chart and legend
Fund details: דמי ניהול, משתנים, נאמן 0.02%
unsure_meaning: מדד in the sense of these buttons
the dotted underlines under the numbers
not_found: Any comparison with a bank deposit or how safe this is
A plain sentence explaining the coloured bars
The inflation percent written on the main screen without pressing a button

findings.what: The page opens with English letters and stock-index words, with nothing about safety or deposits, so someone like me would leave on the first screen
The inflation assumption (2%) is hidden behind a button. The main line only says "בכסף של היום"
The cost chart is busy and colourful with a big red-pink stripe. I couldn't tell what it means and it worried me
The return of 7% a year is just set there with no warning that the fund can fall
Dark background with grey small text is hard to read with my glasses
findings.where: Whole page, e.g. "אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל"

findings.what: Many words I don't know: קרן מחקה, נאמן, דמי משמרת
